reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: Seize opportunities, guard against dangers
themes.definition: AI is framed as bringing hope and opportunity along with risks that must be guarded against.
themes.inclusion: Include passages explicitly pairing AI opportunities with risks or dangers.
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages that mention only one side.
themes.boundary_cases: If specific risks (crime, terrorism, military misuse) are named, also code those themes.

examples.quote: Artificial intelligence brings hope, but also poses risks that must be comprehensively addressed.
come with opportunities that we must seize, as well as dangers that we must guard against
Artificial intelligence is creating enormous opportunities for human development, But it also entails genuine risks.

themes.label: Normative framework grounded in law and ethics
themes.definition: Call for international standards or a new normative framework on AI based on law, shared ethics and human rights, accessible to all states.
themes.inclusion: Include calls for international AI standards, norms or frameworks.
themes.exclusion: Exclude calls for dialogue without normative content, unless tied to a governance process.
themes.boundary_cases: References to the Global Digital Compact or Global Dialogue are also AI_UN_ROLE.

examples.quote: It is now up to the international community to establish appropriate standards to ensure that the technology is used ethically
a new normative framework on AI. based on law and shared ethical principles, respecting human rights and being accessible to all states

themes.label: UN must not remain a spectator
themes.definition: The UN is urged to act on AI through the Global Dialogue on AI Governance and the Global Digital Compact.
themes.inclusion: Include references to UN AI processes or calls for UN action on AI.
themes.exclusion: Exclude generic multilateralism without UN AI reference.
themes.boundary_cases: A call for 'dialogue' without naming the UN is AI_GLOBAL_GOVERNANCE only.

examples.quote: These technologies must remain at the service of humanity, and the United Nations cannot remain a spectator.

themes.label: Misuse by organized crime, terrorism, military
themes.definition: Rapid technological advances including AI may provide fertile ground for organized crime and terrorism and be misused for military or terrorist purposes.
themes.inclusion: Include passages naming crime, terrorism or malicious misuse of AI.
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages focused on autonomous weapons regimes (AI_MILITARY_WEAPONS).
themes.boundary_cases: A brief mention of military misuse within a crime/terrorism framing is coded here; substantive military AI discussion goes to AI_MILITARY_WEAPONS.

examples.quote: provide fertile ground for organized crime and terrorism

value.rationale: Monaco's passages across 2019, 2024 and 2026 consistently use an opportunity-versus-risk framing and call for international, ethics- and rights-based AI norms, increasingly via UN processes; 2024 specifically flags crime and terrorism misuse.
